description: An artifact with payloadAvailabilityState=generating has been in that state for an extended period. The server has not provided a staleness deadline or a stuck diagnostic. The operator UI shows 'Generating...' indefinitely with no escalation path. Violates the server-owned deadline/stalled diagnostic policy for generating and payload_deferred states.
hold_condition: Server-owned generating and payload_deferred states need deadline or stuck diagnostic semantics so the operator UI cannot wait indefinitely with no escalation path.
problem: No stalenessDeadlineAt, no stalledReasonCode, no diagnosticId — operator cannot determine if the server is stuck or still making progress. UI shows 'Generating...' forever.
resolution: Server must either provide stalenessDeadlineAt or transition payloadAvailabilityState to a typed stalled/timed-out state with diagnosticId. Backend fixture must prove this transition with a test.
